title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics + parity fixes, bump SDKs to v1.28.0
author: Alex Chen
description:
Motivation: Our SDK surface has drifted across Python/TypeScript/Go for auth retries and streaming behavior which causes support burden and inconsistent developer ergonomics. This PR unifies the core auth+retry implementation, standardizes streaming APIs (backpressure, reconnect semantics, and chunk framing), fixes language parity issues discovered during the unification, and bumps package versions to v1.28.0.

Summary of changes: unified internal auth client used by all SDKs to implement exponential backoff + jitter and token refresh hooks; retry policy exposed with consistent defaults (max_retries=3, initial_backoff=100ms, max_backoff=2s); streaming client changes to provide explicit pause()/resume() semantics in TS/py and transparent reconnect with resume tokens in go; corrected parameter name mismatches (create_embedding vs embeddings.create) to restore parity; updated examples and changelogs; version bumps to v1.28.0 across SDKs.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement unified auth + retry core and language bindings
- [x] Update streaming API ergonomics and add cross-language docs
- [x] Add/adjust tests for retry/backoff and reconnect paths
- [x] Fix parity gaps and update changelogs
- [x] Bump package versions and prepare release notes

Notes for reviewers: The core retry implementation lives under sdk/common/auth and is wired into existing transport adaptors in each language. Public API surface was kept backward compatible: defaults changed only when they fix unsafe behaviors (e.g. unlimited retries). We had to add a small compatibility shim in redwood-sdk-python for legacy auth plugins - documented in CHANGELOG. CI required a retry of the macos test matrix once due to an unrelated flake; all green on rerun.

Risk and rollout: Low - mainly additive and fixes. The only behavior change is that streaming clients will now attempt one automatic reconnect by default when a transient network drop occurs; this is intentional to reduce customer-visible stream breaks. Customers can opt out by setting streaming_reconnects=0 in client config.

release_notes:
- SDKs: unified auth+retry core exposed consistent defaults and token refresh hooks.
- Streaming: improved ergonomics (pause()/resume()), safe reconnect with resume tokens; default single reconnect attempt on transient network errors (configurable).
- Parity: fixed method name mismatches and parameter mapping across Python/TS/Go.
- Version: bumped sdks/python, sdks/typescript, sdks/go to v1.28.0.
